trigger: Police are demanding money to release me
description: What to do if an officer asks you to pay for 'bail' or to be let go.

steps.text: Stay calm and polite. Do not argue or insult the officer.
Bail at the police station is free. You are not required to pay any officer to be released.
If you are not charged, the police must either release you or bring you before a court within the time limit (s.35(4)).
Do not hand over money quietly. If you can, say: 'I understand bail is free. I would like to call my lawyer.'
Note the officer's name, number, and the station. If it is safe, record the request.
Call your lawyer or someone you trust to come to the station now.
You can report an unlawful demand to the police complaint desk, the NHRC, or Legal Aid afterwards.
